visualChapters.title: Vintage Car Meetup
visualChapters.description: Photography from a vintage car meetup — classic lines, chrome details, patina, and the culture around automotive enthusiasm. Capturing both the vehicles and the atmosphere of the gathering.

closingStory: Vintage car meetup — where automotive history comes alive. The lines, the chrome, the patina, and the stories each car carries. A celebration of design that has stood the test of time.
websitePresentation: Automotive event photography — clean presentation of vintage vehicles and meetup atmosphere. Mix of detail studies, environmental shots, and owner portraits.
